notes: Assumes one outstanding request at a time (the A request is stored and applied at its D handshake). Checking resumes at Ed+2 after any relevant write's D handshake, including errored ones, where the shadow stays unchanged. Checking stays off from an A handshake with i_a_intg_flip=1 until reset. The code does not depend on GpioAsyncOn or GpioAsHwStrapsEn. I did not compile it or run it in Verilator.
